newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Forestry, Astra boost Swedish shares at end.
newsitem.headline: Forestry, Astra boost Swedish shares at end.

text.p: Share prices ended stronger on Thursday, as drug company Astra climbed on takeover rumours and forestry companies raced ahead.
The bourse's general index closed at 2,258.72, up 1.42 percent in turnover totalling 3.8 billion crowns.
Brokers said trade was jumpy, movements exaggerated and some were fearful of a correction.
"There are many who missed out in the last race who now want to get into the market. No one wants to miss the train," one broker said.
Astra rose seven crowns to 321.5, or 2.2 percent.
A rumour that Swiss drugs giant Roche was interested in buying the Swedish company was behind the gains, although Astra denied it.
"We are not aware of any such thing happening and we certainly would know if it was true," company spokesman Staffan Ternby told Reuters. "You can view this as wild imagination."
Rumours about rising forestry product prices and a stronger dollar pushed forestry shares ahead and the sector index rose 4.64 percent.
Ericsson closed four crowns higher at 203.5.
